# Week 3 Discussion

## load in packages
```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
```

## load in data
```{r}
sb_protected_areas <- st_read(here('week3', "data", "cpad_super_units_sb.shp")) |>  
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_city_boundaries <- st_read(here('week3', "data", "sb_city_boundaries_2003.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_county_boundary <- st_read(here('week3', "data", "sb_county_boundary_2020.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

aves <- st_read(here('week3', "data", "aves_observations_2020_2024.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")
```

## 2. bird observations within PAs in Santa Barbara County

```{r}
pa_birds <- sb_protected_areas[aves, ]
nrow(pa_birds)
```

```{r}
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
  tm_polygons(fill = '#afeeee', alpha = 0.6) +
tm_shape(pa_birds) +
  tm_dots()
```

make 5 km buffer around protected area
```{r}
pa_buffer <- st_buffer(sb_protected_areas, dist = 5000)
pa_buffer_birds <- st_join(pa_buffer, aves, left = FALSE)
```

```{r}
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
  tm_polygons(fill = '#afeeee', fill_alpha = 0.6) +
tm_shape(pa_buffer_birds) +
  tm_dots(fill = 'lavender', fill_alpha = 0.2)
 
```

# find PAs within 15 km of Goleta
```{r}
goleta <- sb_city_boundaries |> 
  filter(NAME == 'Goleta')

st_crs(goleta)$units

```

```{r}
goleta_buffer_15 <- st_buffer(goleta, dist = 15000)
```

```{r}
goleta_intersection <- st_intersection(sb_protected_areas, goleta_buffer_15)
```


```{r}
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
tm_shape(goleta_intersection) +
  tm_polygons(fill = '#afeeee', fill_alpha = 0.6) 
```

```{r}
dangermond <- sb_protected_areas |> 
  filter(UNIT_NAME == "Jack and Laura Dangermond Preserve")

dist <- st_distance(goleta, dangermond)

dangermond_centroid <- st_centroid(dangermond)
goleta_centroid <- st_centroid(goleta)

dist_centroid <- st_distance(goleta_centroid, dangermond_centroid)
```
